_comment: 64 fixed sentences, mixed lengths (04-benchmark-methodology.md §2). Originally authored for this project rather than drawn from an external public-domain text -- deliberate choice: self-authored content has unambiguous licensing (project's own Apache-2.0/CC-BY-4.0), which matters more here than literal adherence to "public-domain sources" wording, since the actual requirement is a fixed, freely redistributable sentence set, not a specific provenance. Referenced by SHA-256 in every result (05 §2's fixture_sha256 field) -- do not edit in place; a wording change is a suite-version-bumping event (04 §8).
